items.hook: A Proper Marriage (1954) is the second novel in British writer Doris Lessing's five volume, semi-autobiographical, series, Children of Violence.
items.body: The first volume is Martha Quest (1952), and the others are A Ripple from the Storm (1958), Landlocked (1965), and The Four-Gated City (1969). Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The Fall of the Stone City is a 2008 novel by the Albanian writer Ismail Kadare.
items.body: Apart from winning the Rexhai Surroi Prize for the best book of the year, in Kosovo the novel was also shortlisted for the Independent Foreign Fiction Prize in 2013. One of those things you can't un-know.
